description: In the WooCommerce admin panel (already open in Firefox), navigate to Settings > Emails and update the email sender options and template design. Set the 'From' name to 'WooCommerce Store Support' and 'From' address to 'support@woocommercestore.com'. In the Email Template section, set the Header image to 'https://woocommerce.com/wp-content/themes/flavor/flavor/images/woo-nav-logo.svg', Footer text to 'Thank you for shopping with WooCommerce Store!', Base color to '#2C3E50', Background color to '#F0F0F0', Body background color to '#FEFEFE', and Body text color to '#1A1A1A'. Save changes when done.

expected_settings.woocommerce_email_footer_text: Thank you for shopping with WooCommerce Store!
